-- PARTNER INSTITUTIONS (AX6)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partner_institutions (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  partner_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  country VARCHAR(100),
  type ENUM('university', 'research_institute', 'botanic_garden', 'museum', 'industry', 'ngo', 'government', 'other') DEFAULT 'other',
  focus JSON,
  contact VARCHAR(255),
  mou_status ENUM('idea', 'discussion', 'draft', 'signed', 'active', 'expired') DEFAULT 'idea',
  notes TEXT,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX6_OLFACTIVE_DIPLOMACY',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX pi_country_idx (country),
  INDEX pi_mou_idx (mou_status)
);

-- FELLOWSHIPS (AX6)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS perfumum_fellowships (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  fellowship_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  region_focus VARCHAR(100),
  duration_months INT,
  budget_chf INT,
  deliverables JSON,
  selection_criteria JSON,
  status ENUM('draft', 'open', 'reviewing', 'awarded', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'cancelled') DEFAULT 'draft',
  notes TEXT,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX6_OLFACTIVE_DIPLOMACY',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX pf_status_idx (status)
);

-- RESEARCH EDGES (Graphe de connaissances)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS research_edges (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  from_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  from_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  to_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  to_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  edge_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  weight DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 1.00,
  confidence DECIMAL(3,2) DEFAULT 0.50,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX re_from_idx (from_type, from_id),
  INDEX re_to_idx (to_type, to_id),
  INDEX re_edge_type_idx (edge_type)
);
